sloka: व्यादिदेश प्रियाख्येभ्यः कौसल्या प्रमदोत्तमा ।अथाभिवाद्य राजानं रथमारुह्य राघवः ॥२-३-४८॥
transliteration: vyādideśa priyākhyebhyaḥ kausalyā pramadottamā ।athābhivādya rājānaṁ rathamāruhya rāghavaḥ ॥2-3-48॥

translations.english: Having paid his obeisance to the king, Rama ascended the chariot amidst the acclaim of multitudes of men and left for his splendid abode.
